positions.as_written: Use a sequence with good contrast between cartilage and joint fluid, which the gradient echo family provides.
Use thin slices, because a thin layer is averaged with what is beside it.
Assess the surface separately from the substance, since a surface defect and an internal change are different findings.
Assess the subchondral plate and marrow alongside, because the two change together.
